intents.title: Greeting
intents.answer: Hi there! I'm ORBIT-Bot, Raj's little orbiting assistant. Ask me about his work at Teradata, his AI and backend projects, his tech stack, or how to get in touch.

intents.title: About ORBIT-Bot
intents.answer: I'm ORBIT-Bot, a tiny floating robot that lives in Raj's portfolio. I answer from a pre-fed knowledge file about his experience and projects, either through a small FastAPI service or straight in your browser when the server is offline.

intents.title: About Raj
intents.answer: Raj Dubey is an AI & Backend Engineer at Teradata in Pune. He builds cloud-native systems and LLM-powered tooling, from asynchronous FastAPI services to agentic diagnostics on Kubernetes, and he holds a B.E. in Information Technology from Pune University.

intents.title: Teradata impact
questions: What has Raj achieved at Teradata?
Tell me about Raj's work at Teradata
What does Raj do at Teradata?
intents.answer: At Teradata Raj has worked since Sep 2023. First as a Backend Engineer, building asynchronous FastAPI services, fast Redis-backed reads and observable, rate-limited APIs. Since Sep 2025 as an AI Engineer, connecting LLMs with ELK observability pipelines for faster root-cause analysis, building agentic diagnostics, exposing scoped MCP tools for read-only Kubernetes checks, and supporting GitOps releases with Argo CD and blue-green deployments.

intents.title: AI Engineer role
questions: What does the AI Engineer role involve?
What is Raj working on right now?
Tell me about the AI Engineer job
intents.answer: Since Sep 2025 Raj has been an AI Engineer at Teradata in Pune, connecting LLM reasoning with the signals that production systems leave behind. He integrated LLMs with ELK observability pipelines to support root-cause analysis, built agentic workflows that monitor health and surface cloud optimization ideas, connected MCP servers for read-only Kubernetes diagnostics, and supports GitOps releases through Argo CD and blue-green deployments.

intents.title: Backend Engineer role
questions: What did Raj do as a Backend Engineer?
Tell me about his backend role
What did he do before AI Engineer?
intents.answer: From Sep 2023 to Sep 2025 Raj was a Backend Engineer at Teradata, focused on FastAPI and system design. He built asynchronous FastAPI REST endpoints for BaaS jobs, job details, execution history and scheduled runs, designed a Redis-backed precomputed read path with bounded concurrency, request pacing and a lock against overlapping refreshes, and added timeouts, retries, API versioning, cursor pagination, rate limiting, database design work, structured logging, metrics and OpenTelemetry tracing.

intents.title: MCP and LLMs
questions: How does he use MCP & LLMs?
What does Raj do with LLMs?
How are LLMs used with Kubernetes?
intents.answer: Raj integrates LLMs with ELK observability pipelines so the model can reason over real logs and support root-cause analysis. To keep that safe he connects MCP servers and custom APIs that expose read-only Kubernetes diagnostics with scoped access controls, so the AI can inspect a cluster but never change it.

intents.title: Agentic diagnostics
questions: What agentic workflows has Raj built?
How do his AI agents monitor systems?
intents.answer: Raj's agentic diagnostics are workflows that monitor system health, analyze infrastructure logs and surface cloud optimization strategies. They hand findings to engineers, and any tool access they use is bounded: MCP servers and custom APIs expose read-only Kubernetes diagnostics with scoped access controls.

intents.title: Observability
questions: How does Raj use ELK and observability?
How does he do root-cause analysis?
intents.answer: On the AI side Raj integrates LLMs with ELK observability pipelines to support root-cause analysis and reduce resolution time. On the backend side he worked with structured logs, metrics and OpenTelemetry tracing so every request can be followed across services.

intents.title: FastAPI and Redis
questions: Tell me about his FastAPI & Redis work
What FastAPI services has Raj built?
intents.answer: With FastAPI Raj built BaaS job, execution-history and scheduling endpoints that use typed validation, dependency injection, RBAC and authenticated upstream integrations. To keep reads fast he precomputes job data in Redis, refreshes it in the background with bounded concurrency, pacing and latency-aware backoff, and uses locks so refreshes never overlap.

intents.title: API reliability
questions: How does Raj make APIs reliable?
Does he handle rate limiting and retries?
What about API pagination and versioning?
intents.answer: Reliability is a habit for Raj: timeouts, retries, response normalization, API versioning, cursor pagination and request-level rate limiting are built into the services he ships.

intents.title: Security and access control
questions: How does Raj handle API security?
Does he use OAuth2 or JWT?
intents.answer: Raj works with RBAC, OAuth2/JWT, tenant isolation, and API security with proper secret management. In his MCP tooling, access is scoped and read-only by design.

intents.title: Databases
questions: What database experience does Raj have?
Tell me about indexing and migrations
intents.answer: On the data side Raj works with SQL, database design, indexing, transactions and migrations, and his MicroCloudPy project pairs PostgreSQL and MongoDB with RabbitMQ. He also weighs cache invalidation, capacity planning and database trade-offs.

intents.title: Kubernetes and GitOps
questions: How does Raj handle Kubernetes and Argo CD?
How does he deploy to production?
intents.answer: Raj supports GitOps releases through Argo CD and blue-green deployments at Teradata. In his own projects he deploys to Kubernetes with Minikube, Deployments and Services for the RAG API, and with Helm and kubectl on AWS EKS for MicroCloudPy.

intents.title: Cloud
questions: What cloud experience does Raj have?
Does he know AWS or GCP?
intents.answer: Raj works across AWS and GCP with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitHub Actions and Argo CD. MicroCloudPy ships on AWS EKS with an architecture designed to carry over to GCP GKE too.

intents.title: End-to-End RAG API
questions: Tell me about the RAG project
What is the End-to-End RAG API?
How does the RAG pipeline work?
intents.answer: The End-to-End RAG API is an open-source project: ChromaDB retrieves context, Ollama generates answers locally, and FastAPI ties the pipeline together. It deploys to Kubernetes on Minikube, and GitHub Actions rebuilds the embeddings and runs semantic validation before delivery.

intents.title: MicroCloudPy
questions: What are microservices in his portfolio?
How does the message-driven system work?
intents.answer: MicroCloudPy is a Python microservices system with message-driven communication. Auth and conversion services use PostgreSQL, MongoDB and RabbitMQ, and delivery runs through Helm and kubectl on AWS EKS with a cloud-agnostic design.

intents.title: Aligned Automation internship
questions: What did Raj do at Aligned Automation?
What did Raj do as a Software Engineer Intern?
intents.answer: Before Teradata, Raj was a Software Engineer Intern at Aligned Automation (2022 - 2023). He built component-driven frontends with Vue.js and React.js, managed state with Vuex and React hooks, connected them to Flask and FastAPI APIs with Axios, documented the contracts in Swagger/OpenAPI, and automated Python data-quality checks and SQL demand-profiling stored procedures.

intents.title: Vue.js and React.js frontends
questions: How did Raj use Vue.js & React.js?
What frontend frameworks does Raj know?
How does he build UI components?
intents.answer: At Aligned Automation Raj built modular, reusable UI components with Vue Single-File Components and React functional components, using props, custom events, slots and composition patterns. He used Vue computed properties, watchers and lifecycle methods alongside React memoization with useMemo and useCallback to avoid needless re-renders, and built dynamic forms with v-model in Vue and controlled inputs in React, plus client-side routing and protected views.

intents.title: State management
questions: How did he manage state with Vuex & Hooks?
What is Raj's state management experience?
intents.answer: Raj managed centralized application state with Vuex (stores, actions, mutations and getters) and with React hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext and useReducer), so data flows predictably across views.

intents.title: APIs and data automation
questions: Tell me about his FastAPI, Flask & data automation
How did Raj use Axios with Flask and FastAPI?
Did Raj automate data quality checks?
What are the SQL stored procedures?
intents.answer: On the API side Raj connected frontends to RESTful Flask and FastAPI endpoints through Axios interceptors and custom fetch hooks, handling loading states and error boundaries. He documented request and response models in Swagger/OpenAPI, and automated backend Python data-quality checks and SQL demand-profiling stored procedures.

intents.title: Finding-a-Missing-Person
questions: Tell me about the Finding-a-Missing-Person project
How does the missing person finder work?
Does Raj know OpenCV and TensorFlow?
What is the face recognition project?
intents.answer: Finding-a-Missing-Person (Feb - Mar 2023) is a cloud-based microservices app. FastAPI handles real-time SSE connections and multi-user device sessions, the frontend uses HTMX, Jinja templates and Google OAuth, and OpenCV, face_recognition and TensorFlow handle face detection, feature extraction and similarity matching against images stored in PostgreSQL/Supabase.

intents.title: Projects overview
intents.answer: Raj's highlights are the End-to-End RAG API (FastAPI, ChromaDB, Ollama, Kubernetes), MicroCloudPy (message-driven Python microservices on AWS EKS), Finding-a-Missing-Person (FastAPI, HTMX, OpenCV and TensorFlow face matching), and the AI System Advisor work at Teradata that pairs LLMs with observability data and scoped MCP tools.

intents.title: Tech stack
questions: What programming languages does he know?
intents.answer: Languages and interfaces: Python, Pandas, NumPy, SQL, shell scripting, JavaScript, HTML/CSS and Vue.js. Backend: FastAPI, async programming, REST APIs, Redis, RBAC and OAuth2/JWT. AI: RAG, ChromaDB, Ollama, MCP servers and agentic workflows. Cloud and delivery: AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitHub Actions and Argo CD.

intents.title: Education
intents.answer: Raj holds a B.E. in Information Technology from Pune University, Pune, Maharashtra (Aug 2019 - Aug 2023) with an 8.86 CGPA.

intents.title: Location
intents.answer: Raj is based in Pune, India, and works at Teradata.
